title: Moment 7: Work, Behind a privacy firewall
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Jonas keeps work at work and home at home. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Jonas sees his work day and his personal day side by side.
A firewall keeps the dentist off the work calendar and the budget off the personal side.
When an item is unsure, the assistant asks which side it belongs to.
